title: Etiquette and presentation
learning_outcomes: Explain contextual etiquette in the context of etiquette and presentation.
Compare and distinguish presentation in the context of etiquette and presentation.
Apply hosting in the context of etiquette and presentation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about unfamiliar norms in the context of etiquette and presentation.

lessons.title: Contextual etiquette
lessons.outcome: Explain contextual etiquette in the context of etiquette and presentation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving contextual etiquette; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to event checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain contextual etiquette from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of contextual etiquette; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Presentation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish presentation in the context of etiquette and presentation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving presentation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to event checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain presentation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of presentation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Hosting
lessons.outcome: Apply hosting in the context of etiquette and presentation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving hosting; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to event checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain hosting from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of hosting; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Unfamiliar norms
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about unfamiliar norms in the context of etiquette and presentation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving unfamiliar norms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to event checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain unfamiliar norms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of unfamiliar norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of contextual etiquette; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of presentation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of hosting; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of unfamiliar norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
